briefing.headline: xAI and DeepSeek push open frontier models as US-China compute tensions escalate

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with rapid model releases from major labs and sustained high funding. Regulatory focus sharpens on export controls while safety gaps persist in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: xAI released Grok-4 with enhanced reasoning; DeepSeek-V4 matches closed models on key benchmarks. OpenAI o4-preview shows gains in agentic workflows while Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus enters limited testing.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidance highlights multi-agent risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins volume production of 2nm AI chips; Microsoft and Google announce new $15B+ data center clusters in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed labs by end of 2026?
